nodes.name: en.json
nodes.summary: English localization bundle for the TSD warehouse PWA, providing 108 UI translation keys covering documents, operations, inventory, scanning, QR sharing, and toast notifications.
nodes.languageNotes: Flat key-value JSON with dotted namespaced keys (e.g. doc.movement.create.title) used by the PWA i18n loader.

nodes.name: ru.json
nodes.summary: Russian localization bundle for the TSD warehouse PWA, mirroring the same 108 UI translation keys for documents, operations, inventory, scanning, and notifications.
nodes.languageNotes: Flat key-value JSON sharing identical key structure with en.json and uz.json.

nodes.name: uz.json
nodes.summary: Uzbek localization bundle for the TSD warehouse PWA, mirroring the same 108 UI translation keys for documents, operations, inventory, scanning, and notifications.
nodes.languageNotes: Flat key-value JSON sharing identical key structure with en.json and ru.json.
